summary: Iter22 retest. Backend: a new 9-test file (test_iter22_small_pool_outfit.py) plus a regression run of the iter21, iter17 and iter16 files (40 tests), all passing. Frontend (375x667 web): CRITICAL FIXED: the opening video now plays on its own. paused=false and currentTime advances (1.76s, 3.76s, 5.76s; duration 14.8s). It closes itself on playToEnd at about 16s and goes to /login for guests; the 25s safety timeout was never needed. LEWATI goes to /login. Google-only login works with no 'Main tanpa login'. Guests are sent to /login from /dressing-room, /store, /profile and /f100. MEDIUM FIXED: opening /dressing-room directly, the back button goes to '/' with no GO_BACK error. Opening it directly again with a fresh user (no outfit), picking character/top/bottom/shoes and pressing SAVE shows the 'Tersimpan!' alert and goes to '/'. The hero-mascot shows the 4 picked layers, and the outfit is saved on the user in the DB. HIGH FIXED (iter17): Classic trivia, which has 1 question, shows the header Q1/1. The result shows BENAR 1 / SALAH 0 / 100%, and POST /api/scores returns 200 with total=1 when answered right away (no 422). The backend still rejects a fast 10-question submit (422 game_too_fast). MEDIUM FIXED (iter17): admin UBAH pre-fills the score 2-1, the scorers and the MOTM. The empty-state 'PILIH KATEGORI LAIN' keeps the mode (/category?mode=time_attack). Regression: store, leaderboard, profile, f100 and tournament all open from home while logged in. No deprecated packages (expo-video is used).

issues: Selected and unselected scorer/MOTM chips are hard to tell apart (active rgb(74,21,33) vs inactive rgb(40,44,52) on a dark modal). Add a stronger border or fill for the active chip. There is still no close/X button (iter17 LOW).
The 'PILIH KATEGORI LAIN' (back-to-category) CTA is 41px tall, under the 44px minimum.

action_items: LOW: Make the active chip state in the admin result modal clearer, and add a close button.
LOW: Raise the back-to-category CTA minHeight to 44.
